_doc: Steel structure and welded mesh of the court fence (GDD 2, GDD 10), read by asset_lib/court_frame_layout.py and blender/build_court_frame.py. Lengths in metres. Wall positions and panel extents come from CourtSpec.h; this file only holds the steel sections and hardware sizes. The glass agent's fixings (glass.json) assume the post depth and gasket below, so change them together.

post._note: Rectangular hollow section, 100 across the joint so both glass bolt rows (35 mm in from each panel edge) land on steel, 50 deep.

glass._note: The post's court-side face sits this far outside the court limit: 12 mm glass plus a 3 mm EPDM gasket.

cap._note: Moulded plastic end cap on every post top.

panel_frame._note: Each mesh panel is welded into a frame of rectangular tube, bolted to the court side of the posts, flush with the glass inner face.

base_plate._note: Welded to the post foot and anchored to the slab, on the outside of the court limit.

bolts._note: Galvanised hex nuts and washers: M16 anchors on the base plates, M10 on the panel brackets.
